title: Ely - illiyin
html:
Graph connections

Root

  • Elw - high

Meaning

illiyin · Lemma عِلِّيّ

Surahs (1)

  • 083 Al-Mutaffifin

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali) + Urdu. Showing up to 10 verses in (web app shows all).

83:18 · 083 Al-Mutaffifin

كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

Word in this verse: عِلِّيِّينَ — Illiyin

English (Sahih International): No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

English (Yusuf Ali): Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): (یہ بھی) سن رکھو کہ نیکوکاروں کے اعمال علیین میں ہیں

83:19 · 083 Al-Mutaffifin

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

Word in this verse: عِلِّيُّونَ — (is) Illiyun

English (Sahih International): And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

English (Yusuf Ali): And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور تم کو کیا معلوم کہ علیین کیا چیز ہے؟
